article.title: Estoppel against denying signature or capacity of prior party.
article.content: No indorser of a negotiable instrument shall, in a suit thereon by a subsequent holder, be permitted to deny the signature or capacity to contract of any prior party to the instrument.
article.html:
122Estoppel against denying signature or capacity of prior party.

Section 122 · Chapter XIII · page 26 of the Act

No indorser of a negotiable instrument shall, in a suit thereon by a subsequent holder, be permitted to deny the signature or capacity to contract of any prior party to the instrument.
